title: Tell us your story, and we might read it on the CodeNewbie Podcast 🎙️
why_read: A podcast call-for-stories post with no technical content, relevant only to aspiring guests rather than engineers seeking technical insight.
analysis: This is a promotional post from the CodeNewbie Podcast's new host asking listeners to submit their personal coding journey stories for possible feature on the show. It contains no technical content, code, or engineering analysis, functioning purely as a community callout. It may be of mild interest to beginners wanting visibility but offers nothing for a technical digest focused on substantive engineering content.
